name: ugee Drawing Tablet M908

description_html:
Larger Space unleash your creativity

Enhance your artistic experience with a spacious 10x6.25inch working area on the M908, allowing you the freedom to unleash your creativity at will.


New-Gen Battery-Free Stylus

Experience the ultimate upgrade with our new generation of stylus PH23, equipped with advanced Passive Electromagnetic Technology. Compared to traditional stylus, the PH23 significantly controls the swing aperture of the nib to＜0.1mm, ensuring precise and smooth drawing without any unwanted oscillations or rebound.


8 Shortcut Keys and Scroll Wheel to improve drawing efficiency

The M908 drawing tablet is equipped with 8 customizable shortcut keys and Scroll Wheel conveniently positioned with a textured design for easy blind operation, easily got started and stayed focused on your creative process without distractions, greatly improving drawing efficiency.


Customize your preference

The default settings of shortcut keys are commonly used drawing tools such as pen, eraser, brush size adjustment, and undo, etc. You can also customize the shortcut keys through the computer according to your preferences.


Type-C Port for Seamless Connection

The M908 comes equipped with a mainstream Type-C port, allowing blind plug-in for enhanced convenience. With just one USB-A to C cable, you can effortlessly connect the drawing tablet to your computer, laptop, Android phone and tablet, and jump-start your creative process instantly.


Draw on the Android Phones/Tablets

In addition to computers, the drawing tablet also supports Android phones to connect and use. The default vertical board state when connecting, fits the mobile phone drawing habit.


Compatible with Multiple System&Software

Support Windows 11/10/8/7, Mac OS X 10.13~10.10, Chromebooks (Note: Chrome Os 88.0.4324.109 And Newer Versions Are Required), Android 6 (or latter) and Linux systems. Support Medibang, Clip Studio Paint, SAI, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Corel Draw, Corel Painter, Sketchbook, Manga Studio, Etc.

description_html_ar:
جهاز لوحي للرسم Ugee-m908


ارسم أو صمم أو اكتب على جرافيك تابلت بمساحة عمل كبيرة تبلٌغ 10×6.25 بوصة 


ارسم بدقة مع قلم لا يحتاج بطارية أو شحن
ويدعم 16,384 مستوى من مستويات حساسية الضغط *( بعد تحديث برنامج firmware )
كما يدعم القلم ±60° من حساسية الإمالة.


اختصر وقتك
أدواتك المفضلة فى ضغطة واحدة مع 8 مفاتيح اختصار وعجلة دائرية  يمكنك تخصيصهم وفقاً لسير عملك.

وصل أجهزتك بسهولة
باستخدام كابل USB-A إلى C واحد فقط، يمكنك توصيل الجرافيك تابلت بالكمبيوتر واللاب توب  وموبايل Android والتابلت بكل سهولة.

متوافق مع أنظمة وبرامج متعددة

Windows 11/10/8/7
Mac OS X 10.13~10.10
Chromebook (ملاحظة: يلزم وجود Chrome OS 88.0.4324.109 والإصدارات الأحدث)
Android 6 (أو أحدث)
Linux
يمكنك تشغيل تابلت الرسم  مع معظم برامج الرسم المختلفة مثل:
Medibang، Clip Studio Paint، SAI، Adobe Photoshop، Illustrator، Corel Draw، Corel Painter، Sketchbook، Manga Studio، وأكثر من ذلك.
